details.releaseNotesExcerpt: ## What's Changed * `ollama launch claude` now applies the model's output token limit for Claude Code, so cloud models no longer run into the 128k default cap * Cloud web search responses on `/api/chat` are now decoded correctly, including compressed responses * OpenAI-compatible endpoints no longer override a model's packaged sampler defaults — clients that send no `temperature`/`top_p` get the model's own values instead of 1.0, matching `/api/chat` * `/v1/responses` now preserves readable input content, including prior assistant refusals, instead of flattening it * Ollama's app can now retry ChatGPT disconnect failures instead of leaving the connection in a broken state * `ollama launch codex` verifies ChatGPT routing before configuring, and reports a clear error when routing is unavailable * Faster top-k sampling on MLX for large vocabularies **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.13...v0.40.14

details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> hexagon: tiled hvx permute (#31446) * hexagon: add tiled HVX transpose path for permuted CONT/CPY Permuted copies where dst dim 0 is strided in src, but some other src dim is contiguous, used to fall back to HTP_COPY_KERNEL_RESHAPE. That issues one DMA descriptor per element. The channel-first <-> channel-last permutes around per-channel norms (e.g. [W,H,T,C] <-> [C,W,H,T] in video VAEs) ht this path, and these copies ran at about 45 MB/s. Add HTP_COPY_KERNEL_TRANSPOSE for same-type, same-shape f32/f16 copies into a contiguous dst. Host: - drop extent-1 dims and merge dims that stay adjacent in src into a canonical view, stored in the kernel params. There are no minimum size limits. - the copy is treated as a 2D transpose between dst dim 0 and the contiguous src dim, batched over the remaining dims. - tiles are sized to 64 KB per buffer and halved until they fit in session VTCM. blkk is capped so the halfword vgather offsets fit in 16 bits.
